content: MK concludes that, given the irreparable damage the Hurufis did to his career and lettrist project, Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's feelings toward them were 'understandably' of bitter resentment and naked hostility, and that he consciously synthesized the intellectual and Sufi approaches to lettrism while execrating the popular-messianic, politically subversive Hurufi movement.
